scenarios.name: The Survivors' Camp
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 refuge: a lantern, a few people who stayed, and a way on
scenarios.purpose: A 1536 px quiet room (REST-B, REST-AD13): one continuous ground lane, no enemy, no hazard, no lock and no platform: the plan's 32 px crate stack cannot be a platform (the validator's lane rule needs 52 px of clearance under a deck, and a deck above 42 px needs a lane ceiling), so the crates are a decor rectangle (REST-IMP-8). The entrance marker, the four survivor figures, the central light and the chalk marks are decor rectangles in src/f01_rest.rs.
scenarios.expected: Spawns, the checkpoint under the central light and the exit come from f01_rest_camp.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The room grants nothing; the post-Hoarder pin holds what the run carries.
scenarios.coop: Solo or two players: the route is base movement for every class; nothing here is gated.
